records.title: Merge queues with required status checks reduce integration failures on shared branches

provenance.source: GitHub merge queue documentation and industry practice

records.claim: Testing each candidate against the current target branch head inside a merge queue, with audit approval dismissed on diff change, prevents the class of failures where two individually green changes break when combined.
records.relevance: Directly shapes the Promotion Autopilot merge discipline required by the KCES packet (test against current target branch, dismiss stale approvals).
records.falsifiability: Measure integration-failure rate on this estate with and without queue discipline over a fixed window.
records.limitations: Benefit scales with merge frequency; this estate currently merges at low frequency, so effect size may be small initially.
records.possible_confounds: Changes in agent reliability or test coverage during the comparison window.
records.smallest_meaningful_experiment: Enable required status checks plus branch protection on one repository and record integration failures for 30 days.

records.title: Build-time standalone JSON-schema validators preserve strict CSP (no unsafe-eval)

provenance.source: Kairoth v0.2 packaged-runtime remediation (blank-window root cause: AJV runtime compilation calling new Function under strict CSP)

records.claim: Generating validators at build time and shipping them as static code removes runtime code generation, keeping a strict CSP intact while preserving full schema validation.
records.relevance: Already adopted in Kairoth v0.2; any KCES validator that ships in the cockpit must follow the same pattern.
records.falsifiability: A packaged build containing new Function under CSP default-src self will render a blank window; absence proves the mitigation.
records.limitations: Generated validator bundles are large; regeneration must be deterministic and drift-checked.
records.possible_confounds: None material; behavior was reproduced and remediated with before/after runtime evidence.
records.smallest_meaningful_experiment: Already performed: Kairoth v0.2 before/after packaged-runtime audit.
records.notes: Recorded so the Evolution Memory preserves the lesson with provenance instead of relying on agent recall.

records.title: Quantum-inspired heuristics as candidates for experiment-portfolio selection

provenance.source: Fable 5 architectural hypothesis derived from the KCES packet Lane 2 candidate list

records.claim: Annealing-style or amplitude-inspired selection heuristics may outperform greedy prioritization when choosing which bounded experiments to run under a fixed resource budget.
records.relevance: Lane 2 (quantum_inspired) candidate for the Evolution Lab scheduler; must never be conflated with Lane 1 physically grounded work.
records.falsifiability: Benchmark portfolio value delivered per unit budget against greedy and random baselines on synthetic experiment sets with known optima.
records.limitations: Quantum-inspired labels do not imply advantage; classical simulated annealing is the honest comparator.
records.possible_confounds: Synthetic portfolio distributions may not resemble real experiment value distributions.
records.smallest_meaningful_experiment: A 200-line Node benchmark comparing greedy vs annealing selection on 100 seeded synthetic portfolios; preregistered thresholds; SIPR interpretation stages.
records.notes: Deliberately labeled quantum_inspired per the category law; promotion to any other category requires explicit reclassification.

records.title: SIPR Reconstructed Baseline v0.1 — compatibility-manifold recoherence hypothesis (Lane 1)

provenance.source: SIPR_RECONSTRUCTED_BASELINE_v0.1_20260611.docx, supplied by Manuel in-session on 2026-07-16; author Manuel Rui Santos Ferreira, dated 2026-06-11

records.claim: A fixed post-preparation open-system architecture may autonomously restore phase compatibility toward an independently predicted manifold after bounded perturbation, without measurement-conditioned feedback, in a way not reproduced by matched Markovian revival, autonomous error correction, protected-subspace, synchronization, or hidden-drive comparators. The document itself classifies this as an unvalidated hypothesis and research programme.
records.relevance: Lane 1 physically_grounded anchor. Its methodological discipline (independently predicted targets, preregistered thresholds, comparator battery, morphology-is-not-mechanism, binding resource accounting) is the source of the KCES SIPR Evolution Protocol used for software experiments.
records.falsifiability: Section 8 of the baseline defines discriminating predictions and a comparator battery; the software translation is falsified per-experiment via preregistered failure conditions.
records.limitations: Physics claims are outside software-experiment scope; only the discipline transfers. The baseline explicitly makes no claim of established or novel physics at theorem level.
records.possible_confounds: Conflating drop-recovery-plateau morphology with mechanism; hidden drives; unmatched comparator resources.
records.smallest_meaningful_experiment: For KCES: any software experiment following the protocol (SIPR-EXP-001 is the first). For physics: the module-integration queue defined in the baseline itself.
records.notes: Verified in-session: document received directly from Manuel and digest recorded. Durable import target proposed in IMPORT_PLAN.md (apps/ace-quantum in Jester-Intelligence); the binary is deliberately NOT committed to this agent-writable playground.
